claims.exact_statement: For a one-dimensional iid two-phase series-resistor chain with conductivities 1 and K, cell size ell, and high-phase probability p in [1/4,3/4], a complete two-terminal DtN measurement recovers each coupon's high-phase cell count below the stated resistance-rounding error. With M independent cells, minimax absolute-error risk for A(p)=(1-(1-1/K)p)^(-1) is between D_K/(82 sqrt(M)) and D_K/(2 sqrt(M)); sufficient and necessary high-confidence sample laws both scale as D_K^2 epsilon^(-2) log(1/delta) in the report's regime.
assumptions: Strict one-dimensional series geometry.
Independent identically distributed binary cells and supplied contrast K and cell length ell.
Aligned coupons and complete calibrated two-terminal response map.
Resistance error small enough to decode the integer cell count.
claims.novelty_boundary: The restricted 1D minimax statement is reconstructed here; no priority claim. General d>=2 strict finite-range full-DtN lower bounds remain UNKNOWN.
claims.costs: M total cells, boundary drive/readout precision, K and ell calibration, coupon independence, contact resistance, and any seam conductances for periodic-RVE comparators.
claims.falsifier: Failure of resistance quantization, binomial decoded counts, or the predicted effective conductivity under calibrated error rejects the iid series-resistor model, not the conditional theorem.

claims.exact_statement: Under a finite-volume reciprocal reaction-diffusion graph model, Gamma-mixture counting-process confidence sequences acquire stationary per-mode rate intervals. Exact endpoint checks bound every box-face reaction margin; after subtracting the symmetric heterogeneous-volume hop collar loss C_{i,s} ell_q/alpha_i, positive margins allow the finite-volume N35 exponential exit theorem to apply uniformly to data-selected stopping and predictable switching among finitely many certified modes. A gate on operational bound epsilon_target gives joint pilot-coverage-failure-or-exit risk at most delta+epsilon_target.
assumptions: Correct factorial reaction propensity, integer molecule counts, and reciprocal finite-volume hopping law.
Complete event labels and known predictable exposure; coefficients stationary per finite mode and within justified caps.
Graph, stoichiometry, box, collars, volumes, and initial gaps are supplied.
Every effective face margin is strictly positive; operation uses only the certified finite mode menu.
claims.status: internally_derived_conditional_acquired_certificate; arithmetic and synthetic pipeline checks passed
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard confidence-sequence and interval-arithmetic ingredients are composed with an internally reconstructed box/reciprocal heterogeneous-graph N35 extension. Priority is unknown. This uses N35 only; it neither proves nor assumes N33 permanence.
claims.costs: The synthetic gate uses 50,000 supplied pilot events and 240,000 exposure units; physical event classification, assay time and energy, reset, feed, drive, waste, graph scaling, controller latency, and nature-model validation are unmeasured. The example operational V*Lambda*T event envelope exceeds 7e16.
claims.falsifier: Nonreciprocal hopping, invalid propensity covariates, drifting rates, hidden/missed channels, a nonpositive face margin, or held-out operational departures beyond the model envelope blocks use as a material certificate.

claims.exact_statement: In two independent periodic 1D hard-core channels with N positive and N negative ions, vacancy hops at rate gamma, and total unlike-bond activity F, the finite-ring collective EH conductivity is beta*q^2*a*gamma*N(L-N)/(A*L*(L-1)). The matched finite-ring tagged-ion diffusivity yields a self-only Nernst-Einstein estimate smaller by exactly N; at fixed density, that estimate tends to zero while collective conductivity remains positive. Integrated activity has the report's reversible-gap/Chebyshev finite-time error bound.
assumptions: Exact channelized SSEP generator; independent periodic channels; canonical stationary starts for the finite-time bound.
Uniform nearest-neighbor rate gamma, hard-core occupancy, no cross-channel exchange, known beta/q/a/A/L/N.
claims.novelty_boundary: Collective current correlations and 1D tagged-particle subdiffusion are established. This is a model-specific exact calculation; no material prediction or priority claim.
claims.costs: Requires event-resolved occupancy or charge-current history, beta, q, geometry, gamma, and stationary initialization; event simulation cost O(R gamma L t); no molecular dynamics or material fitting performed.
claims.falsifier: For nature, nonuniform rates, passing particles, long-range interactions, solvent motion, or disagreement between measured activity and independent bulk conductivity rejects the model transfer.

claims.exact_statement: For a finite reversible Arrhenius graph, the capacity/escape exponent from A to B is the minimum over A-to-B paths of the largest transition level along the path. A three-state family with identical vertex energies but one shifted edge level separates the escape exponent by delta, so every predictor using only static state energies/saddle data common to the family has worst-case absolute error at least delta/2.
assumptions: Finite reversible Arrhenius CTMC with known graph and temperature scale.
Static-only predictor receives the same vertex energies and supplied saddle summary across the two alternatives.
claims.source_prior_art: Cirillo–Nardi–Sohier and den Hollander–Jansen communication-height/capacity theory; full source trail in report.
claims.novelty_boundary: No novelty claim; edge kinetics must be measured to transfer to a material.
claims.costs: Edge-hazard assays, event-time resolution, local equilibration and committor validation are not run.
claims.falsifier: Lumpability, reversibility, local-equilibration, or hazard-stationarity failure invalidates the kinetic certificate.

claims.exact_statement: For a passive complete system at one bath with all ports counted, a full-state reversible closed cycle has zero net work, and an irreversible closed cycle has nonnegative work input W_on=T*Sigma. Shaat–Park 2023 state reversible work delta-W=d-psi but also report a nonzero closed-cycle work; their practical cycle switches contact profile with an actuated slider, while no slider force-displacement history is supplied.
assumptions: Complete device boundary includes material, hidden contact state, slider/actuator, controller, and all work/exergy ports.
One bath, full state returns, thermodynamic first/second-law balance valid.
claims.source_prior_art: Shaat and Park, JMPS 171 (2023) 105163, full PDF and Appendix A.1; source URL and spans in linked reports.
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard thermodynamic passivity theorem. The missing slider port is not evidence that slider work is nonzero or that a physical device violates the second law.
claims.costs: Obtain ABAQUS input/output, slider displacement/reaction, contact state, force/moment histories, thermal flux, and every material/control input; physical test not run.
claims.falsifier: Measure the complete slider force-travel and all-port ledger over repeated full-state cycles; slider work or stored free-energy change can reconcile the reported output.

claims.exact_statement: For profile-independent rectangular uncertainty intervals on thermoelectric moments A,B,C and lattice term a, with B_->0, worst PF is B_-^2/A_+ and worst ZT is B_-^2/[A_+(C_++a_+)-B_-^2]. The prior interval rearrangement reduces robust optimization under a PF floor to endpoint variables.
assumptions: Linear-response moment model and independent rectangular interval uncertainty.
B_->0 and profile-independent moment/lattice uncertainty radii.
claims.status: internally_derived_algebraic_corollary; prior art makes novelty unlikely and unverified
claims.source_prior_art: Maassen and Ding et al.; primary source review and scope in cycle-two report.
claims.novelty_boundary: Boxcar/profile optimization is prefigured. No material-specific or efficiency claim.
claims.costs: No moment covariance, profile measurement, fabrication cost law, or acquisition/precision schedule was supplied.
claims.falsifier: Correlated uncertainty, varying uncertainty radii, non-linear transport, or failure of the linear-response moment model invalidates the rectangular robust formula.

claims.exact_statement: For a finite admitted phase universe with certified intervals E_t<=U_t and E_z>=L_z for every competitor, target global stability is equivalent to U_t lying below the lower hull of all competitor lower bounds, equivalently to a single affine support-plane witness. A panel-only certificate cannot certify omitted-phase bounds. With one hidden destabilizing phase among N candidates, m distinct queries leave Bayes error at least (1-m/N)/2; zero-false-stable risk delta requires m>= (1-delta)N.
assumptions: Finite admitted competitor universe and valid independent energy intervals.
For randomized prevalence sampling, explicit mass and energy-depth assumptions are required.
claims.novelty_boundary: LP duality and hidden-index minimax bounds are standard; no claim of global novelty. Nature coverage is unresolved.
claims.costs: High-fidelity energies for every competitor, structural search, duplicate removal, hull computation, DFT precision, and synthesis costs remain outside the fixture.
claims.falsifier: A missed phase below the declared lower-bound envelope invalidates the global certificate; panel stability alone is insufficient.

claims.exact_statement: Under the cited local Gibbs robustness bound, actual exponent mismatch kappa and iid preparation trace error epsilon_p give every local marginal trace error at most 2(epsilon_p+tanh(kappa/2)); a targeted Pauli expectation adds the finite-shot and measurement-calibration terms derived in the report. For bounded-degree graphs, independent per-term mismatch u gives kappa=O(beta*n*u), so this route does not establish local robustness under extensive uncertainty.
assumptions: N90 predictor interface and exact source assumptions.
Iid preparation traces with known error cap and calibrated local measurement.
claims.source_prior_art: N90/N97 source cards and cited local Gibbs robustness theorem; precise sources and bounds in report.
claims.novelty_boundary: No theorem over arbitrary extensive Hamiltonian uncertainty and no claim that classical predictor acquisition is experimentally free.
claims.costs: Pauli shots or q-copy swap preparations, replica gates, state preparation, calibration, and thermalization time; several remain unknown.
claims.falsifier: An extensive-error family with fixed local prediction error, or failed preparation/measurement bounds, invalidates the claimed operational accuracy.
